{{Quote|You can help by telling me exactly where you saw her.''"<br />"''Well, by glider it's, um, half a day's flight east, turn, um, south at the Caves of Thunder, and then go east again. Then you go&hellip; Oh ''kvark''.|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka and Wicket Wystri Warrick|<ref name="Asha" />}}
The '''Caves of Thunder''' were [[Cave/Legends|caves]] located on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="Asha" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">{{InsiderCite|23|Star Wars Publications Timeline|''Star Wars'' Publications Timeline}} dates the events of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated series, which include the mention of the [[Cave/Legends|Caves]] of Thunder in "[[Asha (episode)|Asha]]," to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] returned to [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] from a distant section of the [[Forest/Legends|forest]], where [[Gender/Legends|he]] encountered a savage, [[Color/Legends|red]]-[[Hair/Legends|furred]] Ewok. When Warrick told his friend [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] about the encounter, she believed that the wild Ewok was her long-lost sister, [[Asha/Legends|Asha]], and asked Warrick where she could find her. Warrick stated that by [[Glider (vehicle)/Legends|glider]], the journey consisted of half a [[Standard day/Legends|day's]] flight east, a southern turn at the Caves of Thunder, and then a turn eastward. Failing to give exact directions, Warrick decided to accompany Kintaka.<ref name="Asha" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Caves of Thunder were first mentioned in "[[Asha (episode)|Asha]],"<ref name="Asha" /> the thirteenth episode of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Paul Dini]] and premiered on [[November 30]], [[1985]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
